source_url: https://www.fortworthtexas.gov/departments/the-fwlab/budget (Ordinance 26-28782, as filed with Tarrant County Clerk 10/08/2026; local PDF: AppData/Local/Temp/ps_budget/fortworth_fy27_ordinance.pdf)
source_pages: Ordinance 26-28782 'Page 2 of 44' — SECTION 1. GENERAL FUND, EXPENDITURES table (adopted dept-grain appropriations, FY2027 Oct 1 2026 - Sep 30 2027)
extraction_notes: Extracted from the adopted appropriation ordinance (not the pre-adoption 'Recommended' narrative book, whose tarrant_fw_fy27.pdf copy is the Aug 11 Recommended version and was rejected). Ordinance GF EXPENDITURES table gives department-grain adopted totals. Sum of 21 depts + Non-Departmental = 1,160,365,677 vs published GF total $1,160,365,677 -> delta 0 (verified by direct arithmetic on source-line tokens, whitespace in printed amounts normalized). GF revenues in same section sum to same $1,160,365,677 (balanced).
honest_gaps: General Fund only; enterprise/special-revenue fund dept detail (water, aviation, etc.) not extracted — ordinance carries it fund-by-fund but task asked for the adopted book's dept totals; GF is the tax-supported appropriation core.
Non-Departmental ($62,913,905) excluded from per_department_totals and reported separately: it is a designation, not a department.
FY2026 Adopted column exists in the Recommended book narrative tables (fortworth_fy27_ordinance is FY2027 only) — FY2026 column not carried here.

source_url: https://www.houstontx.gov/budget/26budadopt/ (FY2026 Adopted Budget, component volume: https://www.houstontx.gov/sites/default/files/migrated/budget/26budadopt/II_GFS.pdf 'General Fund Summary'; cross-checked VIII_GG.pdf 'General Government')
source_pages: II_GFS.pdf printed pp. II-2 & II-3 ('GENERAL FUND SUMMARY', Fund 1000) — department expenditure rows, FY2026 Budget column; VIII_GG.pdf p. VIII-3 (Business Area Budget Summary, General Government 1000/9900)
extraction_notes: GF adopted expenditures/other uses by department from the General Fund Summary table. Sum of 22 departments = 2,312,716,168. Plus General Government (non-departmental citywide costs, business area 9900) = 278,099,662 -> 2,590,815,830 matches the book's published 'Total Expenditures Other than Debt/PAYGO' of $2,590,815,830 exactly (delta 0, cross-checked arithmetically from source rows). Adding Debt Service/PAYGO of 456,954,442 (= published $3,047,770,272 total minus non-debt expenditures) reconciles to the known citywide GF adopted total $3,047,770,272 with delta 0. Column mapping of the PDF table verified row-by-row (Fire 690,597,131 = FY2026 = FY2025 Current Budget; the GFS prints FY2026 Budget first).
honest_gaps: General Fund only — enterprise (Airports, Convention & Entertainment, Combined Utility) and other fund dept detail is in separate volumes (IV_/V_ volumes carry all-funds dept detail, not extracted).
General Government ($278,099,662) is a non-departmental citywide bucket (Chapter 380 payments, LGC transfer, OPEB, claims) — reported separately, NOT inside per_department_totals.
Debt Service/PAYGO ($456,954,442) and the small rounding difference inside GG between 'Total M&O' and 'Total Expenditure' lines are excluded from per_department_totals.
GFS footnote: 'may not agree with some of the departmental totals due to prior year restatements' — dept rows here are the FY2026 Budget column as printed.

source_url: philly_bib_fy26.pdf (local: AppData/Local/Temp/ps_budget/philly_bib_fy26.pdf) = City of Philadelphia 'The Mayor's Operating Budget in Brief for Fiscal Year 2026 — AS ADOPTED BY THE COUNCIL, June 2025' (philadelphiacity.gov budget in brief publication)
source_pages: Ordinance (Bill No. 250196) reproduced in the adopted In Brief, printed pp. 84-96 (PDF pages 86-98): SECTION 2 appropriations from the GENERAL FUND, items 2.1-2.70, each with line-item breakdown and 'Total'
extraction_notes: Parsed every 'Total' of SECTION 2 items 2.1-2.70 from Bill No. 250196 as printed in the FY2026 adopted In Brief. Sum of all 70 appropriation lines = $6,842,559,000, which equals the ordinance's stated SECTION 2 total 'six billion, eight hundred forty-two million, five hundred fifty-nine thousand dollars' ($6,842,559,000) EXACTLY — delta 0. Cross-checks consistent with the In Brief's Obligation Comparison table (Total Obligations FY2026 Adopted $6,842,559 thousand) and page-10 obligations pie ($6.843B). Each ordinance line is a complete adopted appropriation to one office/department/board; same-department sub-lines (e.g., 2.22-2.25 Public Property; 2.33-2.42 Finance) are kept as separate rows at the ordinance's legal grain.
honest_gaps: Grain is the ordinance's appropriation-line grain (70 lines), not a post-rollup 'department' count — sub-appropriations within an agency are listed separately as the ordinance does.
Sinking Fund Commission line (2.44) bundles GF debt service of $231,495,486; Fringe Benefits (2.36) $1,745,587,635 is a citywide benefits pool — both are citywide transfers, not service departments.
Line 2.49 (Convention Center Subsidy $15,000,000) total was parsed from the continuation page and is included; verified only via the exact-6,842,559,000 checksum.
General Fund only; Water Fund (Section 3, $1,132,350,000) and other fund appropriations in the same ordinance not extracted.

source_url: https://data.cityofchicago.org/Budget/6694-f78c (official Socrata dataset 'Budget - 2026 Budget Ordinance - Appropriations', 3,268 appropriation line items; fetched 2026-11-22 via resource API)
source_pages: Socrata dataset rows 1-3,268: fields fund_code/fund_description, department_number/department_description, appropriation_authority, appropriation_account, _ordinance_amount_ (adopted ordinance amount). Grouped client-side (pandas-free) by department_description; every row's value included once. Row sum cross-check by fund_description grouping also = $18,668,568,460.
extraction_notes: Grouped all 3,268 ordinance appropriation lines by department and summed _ordinance_amount_. Total across 41 department groupings = 18,668,568,460 (18.67B gross) — reconciles with the known ~$18.67B gross appropriation total within +/-$1.5M of the rounded figure; the Socrata dataset total is the exact adopted-ordinance gross. Corporate Fund total from the same rows = $6,251,207,392; budget summary net figure (~$16.84B) is after deductions/transfers and is NOT gross, so it is not the comparison target. Departments span GRANTS + LOCAL fund types in the dataset; sums here merge all fund types per department (all-funds appropriated grain).
honest_gaps: 'Finance General' ($8,190,935,451, appropriation authority 2005) is a citywide bucket inside the dataset (pension property-tax levies ~$2.9B, Bond Redemption & Interest $430M, debt service, O'Hare/Midway/Water/Sewer non-Corporate funds routed through it, citywide fringe/indirects); it is NOT an operating department. Kept in per_department_totals for the explicit instruction to group ALL dept rows and reconcile to the $18.67B gross, but excluded from any admin-% style per-department service spending math (same poison class as LA's non-dept rows).
Dataset has no separate net/gross flag: grant-fund and internal deductions are as-printed in the ordinance.
Department grain is 'department_description' from the ordinance dataset; no sub-department rollup applied.

source_url: City of Los Angeles 'Budget Summary FY 2026-2027' (local: AppData/Local/Temp/ps_budget/la_summary_fy2647.pdf; city publication la City Budget Summary adopted FY 2026-27)
source_pages: Budget Summary pp. 25-26 (PDF pages 27-28): EXHIBIT A 'SUMMARY OF APPROPRIATIONS Classified by Object of Expenditure' — 36 department rows with Salaries/Expenses/Equipment/Special columns, 'Total-Budgetary Departments' row, then 'Total-Non Departmental' block
extraction_notes: Extracted the 36 BUDGETARY DEPARTMENTS rows (using each row's Total column = sum of Salaries+Expenses+Equipment+Special). Sum of 36 departments = 5,638,075,801 equals the published 'Total-Budgetary Departments' = $5,638,075,801 EXACTLY (delta 0), and also equals the published column cross-add Salaries $4,947,720,166 + Expenses $623,453,553 + Equipment $28,805,446 + Special $38,096,636. Non-departmental rows (Bond Redemption, Capital Finance, TranNotes, Human Resources Benefits, Wastewater, Prop A/C, etc., Total-Non Departmental $8,468,367,523) are EXCLUDED from per_department_totals per the LA special law — reported separately under non_dept_rows. Grand total of the whole appropriated budget (departments + non-departmental) = $14,848,242,440 as published on p.26.
honest_gaps: This is the appropriated-budget summary grain: proprietary departments (LADWP, Harbor, Airport — TRANO) are excluded from this table by construction (they appear only as proprietary-fund appropriations inside non-departmental/other special purpose funds) — no double-count risk carried forward.

Recreation and Parks appears only via its 'Appropriations to Recreation and Parks Fund' transfer line ($309,157,575) in the Total-Appropriations block, not as a budgetary-department row — excluded per instruction and noted.
Grand total $14,848,242,440 includes non-departmental; per-dept gold-check delta is vs Total-Budgetary Departments only.
